title: Can decision models extract clinical data from cancer pathology reports? An evaluation of accuracy, calibration, and failure modes
abstract: arXiv:2611.20129v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decision models are a new class of language model that, instead of generating text, choose one option per question from a fixed list and return a probability for every option. They have not yet been evaluated on clinical text. We evaluated two open-weights decision models, Nimble 9B and Tev1 4B, for extracting 25 fields from 1,113 oral cavity cancer pathology reports from a single centre, against a prospectively maintained clinical database. We compared them with two generative models: Qwen3.5 9B, run locally, and GLM-5.3-flash, run through a cloud API. Tev1 reached a mean field accuracy of 0.917 (95% CI 0.913 to 0.920), the same as Qwen3.5 9B (0.918; p = 0.26), and was four times faster (15 s against 61 s per report). Nimble reached 0.862 and GLM-5.3-flash 0.986. Both decision models matched GLM-5.3-flash on simple dichotomous categories. They were weak on measurements binned into categories, on fields whose correct answer was not rep

translated_title: 决策模型能否从癌症病理报告中提取临床数据？对准确性、校准与失败模式的评估
translated_abstract: 决策模型是一类新型语言模型，它不生成文本，而是针对每个问题从固定选项列表中选择一个选项，并为每个选项返回一个概率。此前这类模型尚未在临床文本上得到评估。我们评估了两个开放权重的决策模型——Nimble 9B 和 Tev1 4B——从单一中心的 1,113 份口腔癌病理报告中提取 25 个字段，并与前瞻性维护的临床数据库进行对比；同时与两个生成式模型进行比较：本地运行的 Qwen3.5 9B 和通过云端 API 运行的 GLM-5.3-flash。Tev1 的平均字段准确率达到 0.917（95% CI 0.913–0.920），与 Qwen3.5 9B 相当（0.918；p = 0.26），且速度快四倍（每份报告 15 秒对 61 秒）。Nimble 达到 0.862，GLM-5.3-flash 达到 0.986。两个决策模型在简单的二分类项目上与 GLM-5.3-flash 表现相当，但在被分箱为类别的测量值、以及正确答案未在报告中明确表述的字段上表现较弱。
tldr: 该研究首次在临床文本上评估决策模型，发现 Tev1 从口腔癌病理报告中提取 25 个字段的准确率（0.917）与生成式模型相当且速度快四倍，但在分箱测量值和答案未明确表述的字段上表现较弱。
en_tdlr: Decision model Tev1 extracted 25 clinical fields from oral cavity cancer pathology reports with accuracy (0.917) matching a generative LLM while being four times faster, though both decision models were weaker on binned measurements and fields whose answers were not explicitly stated.
